lines.text: How was the dance class in the square yesterday?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: It started to rain right before the class.
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: Did the teacher cancel the class because of the rain?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: No. First, she checked a room at Maple Hall.
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: What happened after she checked the room?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: Then we carried the speakers inside and started dancing.
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: Were you happy with the new place?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: Yes, I was surprised. We had more space inside.
lines.speaker: Ada
